deploy.command: bun run deploy:prod with CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID set and the logged-in wrangler session

changes: GET /api/recordings returns only { samples }. listRecordings removed from src/worker/store.ts.
Upload id is 16 random bytes in base64url (22 chars). Old short ids still match idSchema ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{3,64}$ and still load.
Upload reply includes deleteToken (32 random bytes, base64url). Only its SHA-256 hex is stored, in D1 table delete_tokens.
DELETE /api/recordings/:id?token= removes R2 raw/<id>.log and parsed/<id>.json, the recordings row, and the delete_tokens row. Wrong token or unknown id gives 404.
